About this item

The Cuisinart CPT-122 Compact 2-Slice Toaster is the perfect countertop companion for your kitchen. This sleek and efficient toaster fits neatly on any countertop while delivering perfectly toasted bread every time.

Key Features:

  • Compact design saves counter space while fitting two slices of bread
  • 7 shade settings from light to dark for customized toasting
  • Bagel function toasts the cut side while gently warming the round side
  • Defrost function safely thaws frozen bread before toasting
  • Reheat function warms previously toasted bread without additional browning
  • Extra-wide slots accommodate a variety of bread types including bagels and artisan bread
  • High-lift lever makes it easy to remove smaller items
  • Slide-out crumb tray for easy cleaning
  • BPA-free plastic housing in brushed stainless steel finish

Specifications:

  • Dimensions: 11 x 6.5 x 7 inches
  • Weight: 3.5 pounds
  • Wattage: 900 watts
  • Voltage: 120V
  • Color: Brushed Stainless
  • Brand: Cuisinart
  • Model: CPT-122

Customer Reviews Summary

Customers love the compact size and reliable toasting performance. The bagel function is frequently praised. Some reviewers note that the cord could be longer. Overall, this is one of the best-selling toasters in its price range, offering great value for a kitchen essential.
